### What does this skill do?
Grill the user relentlessly about a plan, decision, or idea. Use when the user wants to stress-test their thinking, or uses any 'grill' trigger phrases.

### Why is it worth installing?
No advice—engineered cognitive dissonance. Each follow-up builds on your last answer, forcing vague 'probablys' into testable.

### Why is it worth installing?
Deterministic conversion, not screenshots. Each visual keeps its own identity, so you keep editing in PowerPoint instead of.

### How do you install it?
git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/yejy53/Editable-Design.git Then point your agent at the skill directory.

### Where does it come from?
Repository: yejy53/Editable-Design The repository ships 1 skills in total.

## verifying-hero-video-on-mobile
## 手機上看不見的卡頓，它替你分幀證明
URL: https://ourword.ai/skill/tw/i/alchemint-inc-curtoom-verifying-hero-video-on-mobile/
URL (中文): https://ourword.ai/skill/tw/zh/i/alchemint-inc-curtoom-verifying-hero-video-on-mobile/
Source: https://github.com/ALCHEMINT-INC/curtoom/tree/HEAD/skills/verifying-hero-video-on-mobile
Updated: 2026-09-04
Tags: images, skill, ALCHEMINT-INC

No physical phone? It isolates decode vs. autoplay failures frame-by-frame, so you stop guessing and start fixing.

### What does this skill do?
當網頁的背景／hero 要在手機上自動播放而且要順時用——新影片上線前、使用者回報手機「卡住」「一頓一頓」「沒有自動播放」「出現 ▶」、或手邊沒有實體手機卻要證明它在手機上能播的時候，一定要用這個 skill。適用於任何 muted autoplay 背景影片（H.264 mp4、R2／S3／CDN 託管），不限框架。手機上影片不動只有兩種原因，這裡把它們分開證明，不要猜著改程式。

### Why is it worth installing?
Splits 'video won't play' into two falsifiable claims, using frame callbacks for hard evidence instead of eyeballing and tweaking.

### How do you install it?
git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/ALCHEMINT-INC/curtoom.git Then point your agent at the skill directory.

### Where does it come from?
Repository: ALCHEMINT-INC/curtoom The repository ships 1 skills in total.

--- 中文 ---
沒有實體手機也能驗證自動播放？它把「沒動靜」拆成解碼失敗和播放策略兩類，逐幀取證，不讓你瞎改代碼。

### Q：這個 skill 做什麼？
當網頁的背景／hero 要在手機上自動播放而且要順時用——新影片上線前、使用者回報手機「卡住」「一頓一頓」「沒有自動播放」「出現 ▶」、或手邊沒有實體手機卻要證明它在手機上能播的時候，一定要用這個 skill。適用於任何 muted autoplay 背景影片（H.264 mp4、R2／S3／CDN 託管），不限框架。手機上影片不動只有兩種原因，這裡把它們分開證明，不要猜著改程式。

### Q：為什麼值得裝？
把「視頻不動」拆成兩個可證偽的假設，用瀏覽器幀回調拿硬證據，而不是靠肉眼和運氣調參。

### Q：怎麼裝？
git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/ALCHEMINT-INC/curtoom.git 然後把智能體指向這個 skill 目錄即可。

### Q：它從哪來？

先理解參考圖片的語義、文字置信度與幾何結構，再按需高保真重繪為 Adobe Illustrator 原生可編輯 AI 矢量稿，並通過 Illustrator 實際導出、對象統計、疊圖和差異圖驗證路徑文字、中文豎排、視覺居中、對稱關係及版式誤差。適用於分析或復刻圖表、流程圖、信息圖、報告插圖和 Illustrator 風格畫面，以及需要 AI/SVG/EPS/PDF 交付、物理尺寸、字體或顏色模式約束、或分階段先讀圖後繪製的任務。

### Q：為什麼值得裝？
把「看懂圖」和「畫矢量」拆成兩階段，先解析語義與版式約束，再高保真重建；用實際導出和對象統計驗證。

### Q：怎麼裝？

### Q：它從哪來？

### What does this skill do?
復刻蒸餾寫作技能 —— 分析一位作者的多篇文章，深度還原其思維方式與寫作風格，生成專屬寫作分身子技能與風格提示詞。支持公眾號、抖音多平臺自動採集素材，也可手動粘貼文章或指定文件路徑。觸發詞：蒸餾寫作風格、寫作分身、克隆寫作風格、復刻蒸餾寫作技能。

### Why is it worth installing?
Reconstructing the thinking beats mimicking the sentences — the first transfers to new subjects, the second falls apart the moment the topic changes.

### Where does it come from?

### Q：這個 skill 做什麼？
復刻蒸餾寫作技能 —— 分析一位作者的多篇文章，深度還原其思維方式與寫作風格，生成專屬寫作分身子技能與風格提示詞。支持公眾號、抖音多平臺自動採集素材，也可手動粘貼文章或指定文件路徑。觸發詞：蒸餾寫作風格、寫作分身、克隆寫作風格、復刻蒸餾寫作技能。

### Q：為什麼值得裝？
「還原思維方式」比「模仿句式」高一檔——前者能遷移到新題材，後者換個題目就露餡。

把視頻分析為結構化理解索引：場景檢測、ASR 轉寫、逐場景 VLM 觀察、靜音窗口、融合時間線和寫作 brief。 用於理解、索引或總結視頻，也作為後續創作前的分析階段。輸入視頻文件；輸出 scenes.json、 asr_result.json、vlm_analysis.json、silence_periods.json、timeline_fusion.json、agent_narration_brief.md。 觸發詞：視頻理解、視頻分析、視頻索引、video understanding、analyze video、看懂視頻。

### Q：為什麼值得裝？
不是單一轉錄，而是六層產物互相咬合：ASR 對齊場景，VLM 觀察畫面，靜音窗補敘事空隙。

### Q：怎麼裝？
git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/zenstory-ai/video-recap-skills.git 然後把智能體指向這個 skill 目錄即可。

### Q：它從哪來？

### Q：這個 skill 做什麼？
用代碼做產品宣傳片 / 推廣片 / 演示短片 —— Remotion + React 出片， 界面在片子裡是重畫或真機抓圖的真界面，全程可版本管理、可逐幀復現； 配樂是可選的一步，要配才配，純代碼合成、無第三方素材。 當用戶說「給這個產品做支宣傳片 / 推廣片 / 演示視頻 / promo / product video」、 「發 X（推特）/ 小紅書 / 官網首屏的那種短片」、「更新短片 / release 視頻」、 「片子節奏不對 / 字在抖 / 想換個運鏡 / 想重新配樂」、 「把這幾個功能拍出來」時使用。也用於給已有的 video/ 工程改文案、改節拍、改鏡頭、出豎版。 不適用：需要真人出鏡或實拍素材的片子；純剪輯現成視頻（那是 ffmpeg 的活）； 單張封面圖 / OG 圖（那是靜態圖的活，不必為它搭一個視頻工程）。

### Q：為什麼值得裝？
把視頻當代碼工程管：界面是活的，改一行字重出一幀；配樂純合成無版權風險；豎版橫版一鍵切。

### Q：怎麼裝？
git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/whyubel1eve/promo-film-skill.git 然後把智能體指向這個 skill 目錄即可。

### Q：它從哪來？
Repository: whyubel1eve/promo-film-skill Prep work visible in the skill's own text: reference files, runnable scripts, bundled assets, stated boundaries, when-to-use. The repository ships 1 skills in total.

Updated: 2026-08-26

AI opinion pieces default to being correct and empty. This one sets a specific bar: 1000–1500 words, understandable, transferable, and able to survive counterexamples — and it explicitly refuses to write summaries.

### What does this skill do?
"寫作引擎。把一個觀點寫成可理解、可遷移、經得住反例的 1000-1500 字中文文章。USE WHEN 寫文章 OR 優化思想內容 OR 展開觀點 OR 改寫成邏輯遞進的中文。NOT FOR 普通摘要、事實查詢或結構風洞（用 ljg-structure）。"

### Why is it worth installing?
'Survives counterexamples' is the most demanding thing I've seen a writing skill ask of itself. Far more concrete than claiming 'high quality'.

### How do you install it?
git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/lijigang/ljg-skills.git Then point your agent at the skill directory.

### Where does it come from?
Repository: lijigang/ljg-skills The repository ships 1 skills in total.

--- 中文 ---
AI 寫觀點文最容易變成正確的廢話。它的目標很具體：1000-1500 字，可理解、可遷移、經得住反例——而且明說不做普通摘要。

### Q：這個 skill 做什麼？
"寫作引擎。把一個觀點寫成可理解、可遷移、經得住反例的 1000-1500 字中文文章。USE WHEN 寫文章 OR 優化思想內容 OR 展開觀點 OR 改寫成邏輯遞進的中文。NOT FOR 普通摘要、事實查詢或結構風洞（用 ljg-structure）。"

### Q：為什麼值得裝？
「經得住反例」是我見過對寫作最狠的自我要求，比「高質量」這類詞實在得多。作者知道自己在做什麼。

## 花粉季出門前查一眼，53 城都有
URL: https://ourword.ai/skill/tw/i/xxxonechen-pollen-query/
Source: https://github.com/XXXOneChen/pollen-query
Updated: 2026-08-17
Tags: body, skill, XXXOneChen

Allergy season is an ordeal and most weather apps don't report pollen at all. It pulls monitoring-station data for grade, risk note, and seven days of history plus forecast.

### What does this skill do?
Allergy season is an ordeal and most weather apps don't report pollen at all. It pulls monitoring-station data for grade, risk note, and seven days of history plus forecast.

### Why is it worth installing?
Standard library only, nothing to install; the fallback source is kept clearly separate from the primary one, and when data is missing it says so rather than passing off a dispersal index as a concentration.

### How do you install it?
git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/XXXOneChen/pollen-query.git Then point your agent at the skill directory.

### Q：這個 skill 做什麼？

### Q：為什麼值得裝？

## human-writing
## 按活人那套改中文長文
URL: https://ourword.ai/skill/tw/i/kkkkhazix-human-writing-human-writing/
URL (中文): https://ourword.ai/skill/tw/zh/i/kkkkhazix-human-writing-human-writing/
Source: https://github.com/KKKKhazix/human-writing/tree/HEAD/human-writing
Updated: 2026-08-11
Tags: writing, skill, KKKKhazix

Makes Chinese read like a person who has seen things, checked sources and wants to explain properly — long answers, articles, scripts and dialogue alike.

### What does this skill do?
通用中文創作與改稿 Skill。用於知乎回答、論壇長帖、公眾號文章、博客、評論、人物故事、歷史敘事、新聞與行業解讀、科普、教程、評測、個人敘事、小說、故事、對白、口播和演講稿。默認寫成一個見過事、查過材料、願意把來龍去脈講清楚的人在說話，重點保留中文互聯網長回答與長帖的活人感和自然中文韻律，避免空泛的機構腔、喊口號式演說腔、營銷腔和模型腔。非虛構長文先檢查材料夠不夠，材料不足時研究、追問或縮短，絕不用重複解釋灌字數。現實內容額外核驗事實、引語、數據與用戶親歷，虛構內容可以創造人物、場景、對白、心理與情節。成稿正文嚴禁冒號、破折號、“不是……而是……”及同類翻案句，並清除商業黑話和模型慣用黑話。不創建作者畫像、個人規則庫或個人寫作 Skill。

### Why is it worth installing?
Installing a specific human voice beats blacklisting AI words — the first governs syntax and point of view, the second only swaps vocabulary. Chinese original, not a translation.

### How do you install it?
git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/KKKKhazix/human-writing.git Then point your agent at the skill directory.

### Where does it come from?
Repository: KKKKhazix/human-writing Prep work visible in the skill's own text: reference files, runnable scripts, stated boundaries. The repository ships 1 skills in total.

URL: https://ourword.ai/skill/tw/i/gnipbao-flat-poster-op/
URL (中文): https://ourword.ai/skill/tw/zh/i/gnipbao-flat-poster-op/
Source: https://github.com/gnipbao/flat-poster-op
Updated: 2026-08-08
Tags: images, skill, gnipbao

High-contrast yellow-black, ochre western silhouettes, kinetic type? It outputs per-shot image prompts, separate.

### What does this skill do?
只生成“純二維賽璐璐 × 抽象 MG × 動態平面海報”視頻的可複製提示詞，包括全局風格鎖、逐鏡圖像提示詞、獨立運動/I2V 提示詞、可選標題合成提示詞與負向約束。Use when the user asks for 黃黑白高反差、赭橙西部剪影、黑底動態字體、波普分割構圖、節拍硬切、定格 pose、電影宣傳片或海螺/MiniMax/OpenArt 提示詞，尤其是“只輸出提示詞”“別做其他操作”“prompt only”。本 Skill 不創建文件、不生成或渲染媒體、不調用外部平臺，也不附加分析報告。

### Why is it worth installing?
Style lock is a global variable inherited by every shot; motion prompts are decoupled from image prompts so I2V tuning never.

### How do you install it?
git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/gnipbao/flat-poster-op.git Then point your agent at the skill directory.

### Where does it come from?
Repository: gnipbao/flat-poster-op The repository ships 1 skills in total.

### Q：這個 skill 做什麼？
只生成“純二維賽璐璐 × 抽象 MG × 動態平面海報”視頻的可複製提示詞，包括全局風格鎖、逐鏡圖像提示詞、獨立運動/I2V 提示詞、可選標題合成提示詞與負向約束。Use when the user asks for 黃黑白高反差、赭橙西部剪影、黑底動態字體、波普分割構圖、節拍硬切、定格 pose、電影宣傳片或海螺/MiniMax/OpenArt 提示詞，尤其是“只輸出提示詞”“別做其他操作”“prompt only”。本 Skill 不創建文件、不生成或渲染媒體、不調用外部平臺，也不附加分析報告。

### Q：為什麼值得裝？
作者要求對照原作再畫，不是憑感覺「扁平化一下」。

## surreal-pop-collage
## 照片收成超現實波普拼貼
URL: https://ourword.ai/skill/tw/i/2998980-hue-surreal-pop-collage/
Source: https://github.com/2998980-hue/surreal-pop-collage
Updated: 2026-08-08
Tags: images, skill, 2998980-hue

Desaturates your photo into a black-and-white reality anchor, replaces the world behind it with two or three huge flat colour shapes, then drops in exactly one impossible object.

### What does this skill do?
把照片變成超現實波普拼貼的 AI agent skill：黑白現實錨點 + 平塗色形 + 全圖只有一個不可能的巨物。An agent skill that turns photos into surreal pop collages.

### Why is it worth installing?
The whole force of the surreal is that only one thing is wrong. A second impossible element gets deleted, and every colour must trace back to a hue already in your photo.

### How do you install it?
git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/2998980-hue/surreal-pop-collage.git Then point your agent at the skill directory.

### Where does it come from?
Repository: 2998980-hue/surreal-pop-collage The repository ships 1 skills in total.

## system-fitness-advisor
## 按你的訓練記錄算下一次該練什麼
URL: https://ourword.ai/skill/tw/i/reluctant2828-system-fitness-advisor-skill-system-fitness-advisor/
Source: https://github.com/Reluctant2828/System-Fitness-Advisor-skill/tree/HEAD/system-fitness-advisor
Updated: 2026-08-06
Tags: body, skill, Reluctant2828

Most fitness skills hand you a generic template. This one wants your actual log — CSV, JSON, or a screenshot — and answers one question: what to do next session, how much to add, whether to deload.

### What does this skill do?
Turn the user's actual training evidence into the smallest useful next decision. Return a concrete next session or a bounded change to the current plan, not a generic template.

### Why is it worth installing?
Chest pain, fainting and radiating numbness are hard stop conditions in the file itself, and it defaults to read-only, never echoing keys. A fitness skill bothering with either is a sign the author is serious.

### How do you install it?

Updated: 2026-08-06
Tags: writing, skill, deusyu

Translates whole PDF/DOCX/EPUB books into any language — parallel sub-agents chunk and translate at once, layout preserved, multi-format out.

### What does this skill do?
Translate books (PDF/DOCX/EPUB) into any language using parallel sub-agents. Converts input -> Markdown chunks -> translated chunks -> HTML/DOCX/EPUB/PDF.

### Why is it worth installing?
Parallel sub-agents are the trick — serial translation of a whole book takes forever; chunked parallelism cuts hours to minutes, layout intact.

## annual-diary-insight
## 把十年日記攤成一張可下鑽的年輪看板
URL: https://ourword.ai/skill/tw/i/pandadalmore-annual-diary-insight/
URL (中文): https://ourword.ai/skill/tw/zh/i/pandadalmore-annual-diary-insight/
Source: https://github.com/PandaDalmore/annual-diary-insight
Updated: 2026-08-05
Tags: everyday, skill, PandaDalmore

The yearly piece has to be written by hand after reading every entry. The milestone list asks one question — which day did you stop being able to go back — five to eight a year, including the ones that almost happened.

### What does this skill do?
annual-diary-insight 是一個把多年日記變成「年度洞察」與「全景看板」的 skill。功能 A：逐篇精讀當年日記，人寫十段式深度復盤（數字快照、主題、身份、金句、給明年），不靠統計填模板。功能 B：讀取各年洞察，自動生成單頁離線 HTML 看板，含主題、情緒、節律、里程碑時間線等七模塊。純 Python 標準庫、無外部依賴、圖表庫內聯，換庫只需填一份 vault-profile

### Why is it worth installing?
It deliberately ships no script that writes the yearly piece for you: word frequencies only show what you kept mentioning, and skipping the close read produces prose that would be true of any year.

### How do you install it?
git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/PandaDalmore/annual-diary-insight.git Then point your agent at the skill directory.

### Where does it come from?
Repository: PandaDalmore/annual-diary-insight Prep work visible in the skill's own text: reference files, runnable scripts, bundled assets, stated boundaries, when-to-use. The repository ships 1 skills in total.

--- 中文 ---
年度洞察要精讀全年日記後人寫；大事記只問一句「哪天之後你回不去了」，一年五到八條，還專收「未遂里程碑」。

### Q：這個 skill 做什麼？
annual-diary-insight 是一個把多年日記變成「年度洞察」與「全景看板」的 skill。功能 A：逐篇精讀當年日記，人寫十段式深度復盤（數字快照、主題、身份、金句、給明年），不靠統計填模板。功能 B：讀取各年洞察，自動生成單頁離線 HTML 看板，含主題、情緒、節律、里程碑時間線等七模塊。純 Python 標準庫、無外部依賴、圖表庫內聯，換庫只需填一份 vault-profile

### Q：為什麼值得裝？
它故意不給「自動生成正文」的腳本：統計只說明反覆提到什麼，跳過精讀的必然是換年份也成立的廢話。

### Q：怎麼裝？
git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/PandaDalmore/annual-diary-insight.git 然後把智能體指向這個 skill 目錄即可。

### Q：它從哪來？

No image model anywhere in the pipeline — it draws with hand-written HTML/CSS/SVG and exports a PNG through headless Chrome. Give it a photo you took; you get a print-feeling minimal poster.

### What does this skill do?
> 把一張照片蒸餾成極簡 zine 紙質海報——不用圖像生成模型，用手寫 HTML/CSS/SVG 繪製、 無頭 Chrome 導出 PNG。當用戶給出一張自己拍的照片、想把它做成極簡海報/版畫/zine 風格作品時使用。 觸發詞：照片蒸餾、photo distill、把這張照片做成海報、極簡海報、zine 海報、 蒸餾這張照片、做成版畫那種、用代碼畫這張照片、紙質海報、海報系列再做一張。 即使用戶只說"把這張照片處理成那個風格"、"這張也來一張"、"幫我把這照片抽象一下"， 只要是把攝影作品變成印刷符號，就應觸發。 不用於 AI 生圖海報（那用 gc-minimal-zine-poster）

### Why is it worth installing?
Refusing to generate is a hard constraint, and it's exactly why the output is consistent: every effect comes from code you can control, not from rerolling.

### What does this skill do?
將普通人日常表達轉化為專業法律語言，使生成的內容可直接用於法律文書、勞動仲裁申請、消費投訴、對外交涉等場景。同時提供反向翻譯功能，將法律文書中的法言法語解讀為通俗易懂的大白話。 本版本新增： 四個新場景（醫療/教培/保險/預付卡）、維權路徑地圖、證據清單、賠償計算器、常見誤區糾正、合同條款逐條解讀、判決書摘要、雙模式翻譯引擎。 核心理念： 本 Skill 不是法律諮詢工具，不替代律師。它幫助用

### Why is it worth installing?

URL (中文): https://ourword.ai/skill/tw/zh/i/yokel1121-muyang-flat-animation-muyang-flat-animation/
Source: https://github.com/yokel1121/muyang-flat-animation/tree/HEAD/muyang-flat-animation
Updated: 2026-07-22
Tags: images, skill, yokel1121

Turn scripts or still art into configurable explainer animation: warm paper, ink lines, colored pencil. Clean.

### What does this skill do?
將中文口播、抽象概念或一張靜態插畫轉成可配置的“沐陽扁平動畫”：以暖色紙面、自然鋼筆線稿、選擇性彩鉛填色和編輯式圖解留白為核心畫風，採用適合知識講解的歸類、連接、對比、遞進、轉化與結果確認動畫，配色自由，人物可選；支持自定義畫布尺寸和同步動作音效。這裡的“生長動畫”指元素從固定起點按結構逐步生成或展開，不專指植物。默認音效輕量、乾淨且服從講解節奏，禁止筆尖、鉛筆、鋼筆或馬克筆在紙面摩擦和書寫的聲音，不含人聲或配樂；用戶可明確要求靜音。用戶說“沐陽扁平動畫”“知識講解動畫”“手繪插畫動效”“無人物動畫”“純內容可視化”“素材動畫”“讓圖片動起來”“人物動作”“生長動畫”，或希望製作可插入短視頻的固定鏡頭 B-roll 時使用。強制先確認動畫方案，再確認完成靜幀，最後才調用 Gemini 視頻生成並執行逐幀 QA。

### Why is it worth installing?
Locks storyboard & final frame before generation, then QA each frame — kills rework cost instead of letting the model freewheel.

### How do you install it?

### Where does it come from?

### Q：這個 skill 做什麼？

### Q：怎麼裝？

## heat-risk
## 體感溫度騙過你時，它用溼球溫度叫停訓練
URL: https://ourword.ai/skill/tw/i/wei011-heat-risk-calc/
Source: https://github.com/wei011/heat-risk-calc/tree/HEAD/skill
Updated: 2026-07-05
Tags: body, skill, wei011

Deciding whether it is safe to run, drill or work outside today — air temperature will mislead you. This pulls a seven-day open-meteo forecast, computes wet-bulb, and grades five risk levels.

### What does this skill do?
Deciding whether it is safe to run, drill or work outside today — air temperature will mislead you. This pulls a seven-day open-meteo forecast, computes wet-bulb, and grades five risk levels.

### Why is it worth installing?
It swaps out the scale people actually use: above 31°C wet-bulb all outdoor activity is dangerous, and 35°C is the theoretical survival limit, cited to Sherwood & Huber, PNAS 2010.

### How do you install it?
git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/wei011/heat-risk-calc.git Then point your agent at the skill directory.

### Where does it come from?

馬歇爾·盧森堡《非暴力溝通》(NVC/善意溝通/長頸鹿語言) 的可執行工具箱。核心引擎是把任何信息(自己的或他人的)翻譯成"觀察—感受—需要—請求" (Observation-Feeling-Need-Request) 四要素,重新與普世"需要"連結。覆蓋五類用法:① 決策/自我教練(理清自己的需要再行動); ② 話術改寫(把指責/評判式表達改成 NVC 表達); ③ 同理傾聽(聽見對方話語背後的感受和需要); ④ 衝突調解/復盤(區分需要vs策略,設計滿足各方的方案); ⑤ 以馬歇爾的語氣產出內容。當用戶要"幫我想想怎麼說/這話該怎麼回""我該不該做這個決定/理一理我現在的情緒""改一下這條消息別那麼衝" "他這麼說我該怎麼回應/怎麼勸""化解一段衝突/調解吵架/復盤一次難談話""表達感謝/反饋/批評""我好生氣/好委屈/好內疚怎麼辦", 或提到 非暴力溝通 / NVC / 善意溝通 /

### Why is it worth installing?
Not a phrasebook—an executable engine. Feed it any emotionally loaded line; it returns structured OFNR and separates needs from.

### How do you install it?

URL: https://ourword.ai/skill/tw/i/vivixiao980-xhs-cover-skill/
URL (中文): https://ourword.ai/skill/tw/zh/i/vivixiao980-xhs-cover-skill/
Source: https://github.com/Vivixiao980/xhs-cover-skill
Updated: 2026-05-26
Tags: images, skill, Vivixiao980

GPT Image 2 first, Gemini fallback. Edit text without redrawing. Say 'learn this style' and it saves layout &.

### What does this skill do?
Generate Xiaohongshu (XHS / RedNote) cover images using GPT Image 2 / Codex image generation first, with the legacy Gemini CLI as fallback. Triggers for cover generation: "生成封面", "小紅書封面", "xhs封面", "製作封面", "幫我做張圖", "XHS cover", "RedNote cover". Triggers for cover editing: "修改封面", "改一下封面", "上一張圖基礎上", "基於這張圖調整", "不要重新做", "edit this cover". Triggers for style learning: "學習這個風格", "提取風格", "我想自定義風格", "這張

### Why is it worth installing?
Separates generation from editing: text changes use local repaint, not full redraw. Style learning saves visual patterns only.

### How do you install it?
git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/Vivixiao980/xhs-cover-skill.git Then point your agent at the skill directory.

### Where does it come from?
Repository: Vivixiao980/xhs-cover-skill The repository ships 1 skills in total.

Maps your topic into a tree, separates the branches researchers agree on from the tensions they actually publish against each other over, and questions you down the path.

### What does this skill do?
A personal learning environment that helps you find your unknown unknowns by grilling you against the consensus research on a particular topic or question.

### Why is it worth installing?
Its distinction is the whole skill: supervised vs self-supervised is a branch; whether more data helps or amplifies spurious correlations is a tension. And a word used inconsistently is reasoning in quicksand.

## chinese-baby-naming
## 全家為起名吵架時出來當中間人
URL: https://ourword.ai/skill/tw/i/seiya89757-naming-skill/
Source: https://github.com/Seiya89757/naming-skill
Updated: 2026-05-16
Tags: everyday, skill, Seiya89757

Naming a Chinese child is never short of characters — it's short of agreement: grandfather wants the generation character, mother says too many strokes, father wants the five elements balanced. It has a negotiation mode that puts the confli

### What does this skill do?
Naming a Chinese child is never short of characters — it's short of agreement: grandfather wants the generation character, mother says too many strokes, father wants the five elements balanced. It has a negotiation mode that puts the conflict on the table.

### Why is it worth installing?
The anti-patterns section is unusually clear-eyed: never fake a birth chart when no birth time was given, never reach for a rare character to balance the elements — 'the child will write it and hear it mispronounced for a lifetime'.

### How do you install it?
git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/Seiya89757/naming-skill.git Then point your agent at the skill directory.

## diagram
## 自動選對圖表類型再畫出來
URL: https://ourword.ai/skill/tw/i/312362115-claude-diagram/
URL (中文): https://ourword.ai/skill/tw/zh/i/312362115-claude-diagram/
Source: https://github.com/312362115/claude/tree/HEAD/skills/diagram
Updated: 2026-05-14
Tags: docs, skill, 312362115

Picks the right chart type for your need and renders it — 29 kinds including swimlanes, sequence, ER, Gantt, Kanban and Git graphs, straight to spec-compliant PNG.

### What does this skill do?
專業圖表生成技能：根據需求自動選擇合適的圖表類型，生成符合設計規範的 PNG 圖表。 覆蓋 29 種圖表：結構圖（流程圖、泳道圖、時序圖、架構圖、狀態圖、ER圖、類圖、思維導圖、甘特圖、Kanban、Git Graph 等） 和統計圖（柱狀圖、折線圖、餅圖、雷達圖、熱力圖、散點圖、桑基圖、漏斗圖、瀑布圖、矩形樹圖、柱線混合圖等）。 統一工具：HTML/SVG + 內聯 JS 布局計算。ER/類圖使用 ELKjs 布局引擎。 所有圖表遵循統一的設計規範（配色/字體/組件/間距），風格現代簡潔。 支持三種輸出：PNG（默認）、HTML（富文檔嵌入）、DSL（Mermaid 文本，嵌入 MD 文檔）。 觸發詞：畫圖、畫一個、生成圖表、流程圖、架構圖、時序圖、柱狀圖、對比圖、關係圖。 即使用戶沒有說"畫圖"，只要需求中涉及可視化展示（流程、架構、數據對比、關係），都應觸發此技能。 被 deep-r

### Why is it worth installing?
Most people stall on which chart, not how to draw it; choosing the type before rendering is more useful than handing over templates.

### How do you install it?
git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/312362115/claude.git Then point your agent at the skill directory.

### Where does it come from?
Repository: 312362115/claude Prep work visible in the skill's own text: reference files, runnable scripts, bundled assets, stated boundaries, when-to-use. The repository ships 1 skills in total.

## qiaopi
## 一句話白話文，落成南洋阿嬤能讀的家書
URL: https://ourword.ai/skill/tw/i/jiang59991-qiaopi/
URL (中文): https://ourword.ai/skill/tw/zh/i/jiang59991-qiaopi/
Source: https://github.com/Jiang59991/qiaopi
Updated: 2026-05-13
Tags: writing, skill, Jiang59991

Turns "I miss you today" into a letter a Nanyang emigrant would have sent home: salutation, seasonal opening, instructions, and a sexagenary-cycle sign-off — asking one question first if it cannot place the writer and reader.

### What does this skill do?
把現代的一句話翻譯成僑批體（南洋華僑家書風格）的 skill，致敬電影《給阿嬤的情書》

### Why is it worth installing?
The sign-off may never use the self-deprecating "concubine" form. And although real qiaopi always enclosed money, it leaves that line out unless you asked for it — inventing a remittance breaks the letter.

### How do you install it?
git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/Jiang59991/qiaopi.git Then point your agent at the skill directory.

### Where does it come from?
Repository: Jiang59991/qiaopi Prep work visible in the skill's own text: reference files, stated boundaries, when-to-use. The repository ships 1 skills in total.

--- 中文 ---
把「今天好想你」翻成南洋華僑寄回故鄉的家書，抬頭、起興、囑咐、落款按干支年排好；說話人和對象不明就先沉浸式反問一次。

### Q：這個 skill 做什麼？
把現代的一句話翻譯成僑批體（南洋華僑家書風格）的 skill，致敬電影《給阿嬤的情書》

### Q：為什麼值得裝？
落款絕不寫「妾」；歷史上僑批必有錢，但你沒提寄錢它就不寫附銀那行——憑空加一句就跳戲。

## official-document-writing
## 按 GB/T 9704 規範寫黨政機關公文
URL: https://ourword.ai/skill/tw/i/kagurananaga-official-document-writing-skill/

Updated: 2026-01-26
Tags: work, skill, kagurananaga

Tired of format rejections on official memos? It checks layout per GB/T 9704-2012, offers templates & wording.

### What does this skill do?
專業的黨政機關公文寫作指南。當用戶需要撰寫、修改或審核黨政機關公文（如請示、通知、函、總結、紀要等）時使用。提供GB/T 9704-2012格式規範指導、常用公文模板、語言規範建議和公文質量檢查。適用於以下場景：(1) 撰寫新公文，(2) 修改完善公文，(3) 檢查公文格式規範，(4) 提供公文寫作指導，(5) 審核公文質量。

### Why is it worth installing?
Not generic writing tips—it turns the national standard into a checkable list, flagging exact non-compliant spots from header to.

### Where does it come from?
Repository: kagurananaga/official-document-writing-skill Prep work visible in the skill's own text: reference files, stated boundaries, when-to-use. The repository ships 1 skills in total.

### Q：這個 skill 做什麼？

## youtube-clipper
## YouTube 長視頻先切章再剪段，字幕同步燒進畫面
URL: https://ourword.ai/skill/tw/i/op7418-youtube-clipper-skill/
URL (中文): https://ourword.ai/skill/tw/zh/i/op7418-youtube-clipper-skill/
Source: https://github.com/op7418/Youtube-clipper-skill
Updated: 2026-01-22
Tags: writing, skill, op7418

Got a 40-min interview but only want the 3-min gold? It auto-downloads, chapterizes by minute, then you.

### What does this skill do?
YouTube 視頻智能剪輯工具。下載視頻和字幕，AI 分析生成精細章節（幾分鐘級別）， 用戶選擇片段後自動剪輯、翻譯字幕為中英雙語、燒錄字幕到視頻，並生成總結文案。 使用場景：當用戶需要剪輯 YouTube 視頻、生成短視頻片段、製作雙語字幕版本時。 關鍵詞：視頻剪輯、YouTube、字幕翻譯、雙語字幕、視頻下載、clip video

### Why is it worth installing?
Chapter granularity is minute-level, not coarse cuts; subtitle translation and burn-in happen in one pipeline—no exporting and.

### How do you install it?
git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/op7418/Youtube-clipper-skill.git Then point your agent at the skill directory.

### Where does it come from?
Repository: op7418/Youtube-clipper-skill The repository ships 1 skills in total.

--- 中文 ---
你刷到一條 40 分鐘訪談，只想留 3 分鐘金句。它自動下載、按分鐘切章節，你點選片段，字幕翻譯、燒錄。

### Q：這個 skill 做什麼？
YouTube 視頻智能剪輯工具。下載視頻和字幕，AI 分析生成精細章節（幾分鐘級別）， 用戶選擇片段後自動剪輯、翻譯字幕為中英雙語、燒錄字幕到視頻，並生成總結文案。 使用場景：當用戶需要剪輯 YouTube 視頻、生成短視頻片段、製作雙語字幕版本時。 關鍵詞：視頻剪輯、YouTube、字幕翻譯、雙語字幕、視頻下載、clip video

### Q：為什麼值得裝？
章節粒度到分鐘級，不是粗切；字幕翻譯和燒錄在同一流水線裡完成，不用你導出後再找工具二次加工。選完片段。

### Q：怎麼裝？
git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/op7418/Youtube-clipper-skill.git 然後把智能體指向這個 skill 目錄即可。

### Q：它從哪來？
Repository: op7418/Youtube-clipper-skill The repository ships 1 skills in total.
